questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q:
From the following, the correct statements about polysaccharides are
(I) Starch is a polymer of $\alpha-\mathrm{D}(+)$-glucose
(II) Amylose component of starch is not soluble in water.
(III)Amylose is a branched chain polymer of $\alpha-\mathrm{D}(+)-$ glucose.
(IV) Cellulose is a straight chain polymer of $\beta-\mathrm{D}(+)$ glucose units
questions.solution: Starch is a polymer of $\alpha-\mathrm{D}(+)$-glucose. Amylose is a water soluble component which constitutes about 15 $20 \%$ of starch. Chemically, amylose is a long unbranched chain with 200-100 $\alpha-\mathrm{D}-(+)$ - glucose units held together by $\mathrm{Cl}-\mathrm{C} 4$ glycosidic linkage. Cellulose is a straight chain polysaccharide composed only of $\beta-D$ - glucose units which are joined by glycosidic linkage between $\mathrm{C} 1$ of one glucose unit and $\mathrm{C} 4$ of the next glucose unit.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Which of the following vinyl derivatives is the most reactive towards anionic polymerisation?
questions.solution:
Anionic polymerisation can anionic initiator generates a carbanionic intermediate and such polymerisation is termed anionic addition polymerisation.
In this case, the active centre of propagating species has negative charge. So, it takes place easily with the monomer having electron withdrawing groups such as phenyl, nitrile etc. that are capable of stabilising the propagating species.
Hence, $\mathrm{CH}_2=\mathrm{CH}-\mathrm{CN}$ is the most reactive towards anionic polymerisation.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: Type of reaction involved in the initial step in the formation of bakelite
questions.solution:
Bakelite It was the first plastic made from synthetic components. It is thermosetting phenol formaldehyde resin formed from a condensation reaction of phenol with formaldehyde. When the phenol is taken in excess and the reaction medium is made acidic, the product of the condensation reaction by electrophilic substitution mechanism obtained is acidic, whereas when the quantity of formaldehyde taken is more than that of phenol in the reacting mixture, and the reaction occurs in a basic medium, the condensation product is known as rest.
Initial methods of preparing bakelite involved the heating of formaldehyde and phenol in the presence of ore of the following catalysts $-\mathrm{ZnCl}_2, \mathrm{HCl}$ or $\mathrm{NH}_3$ and shows electrophilic substitution on phenol.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.q: The poly dispersity index (PDI) of a polymer is (\bar{M}_W=$ weight average molecular mass and \bar{M}_n=$ number average molecular mass)
questions.solution: The polydispersity index (PDl) of a polymer is the ratio of $\bar{M}_w$ and $\bar{M}_n$. $\mathrm{PDI}=\frac{\bar{M}_w}{\bar{M}_n}$ It is directly related to the standard deviation of polymer molecular weight distribution. Polydispersity index can be used as a measure of the width of the molecular mass distribution.
